# Tile Charts

Simple 100 percent tile chart.

```mdf-tile-chart
key,value
Build,40
Test,25
Ship,10
```

Sorted tile chart.

```mdf-tile-chart,sort
key,value
Research,12
Design,30
Implementation,44
Verification,18
Release,9
```

Ascending tile chart.

```mdf-tile-chart,sort=ascending
key,value
Trial A,45
Trial B,12
Trial C,33
Trial D,18
Trial E,55
```

Many small values where narrow segments become colored blocks.

```mdf-tile-chart
key,value
S01,4
S02,5
S03,6
S04,7
S05,8
S06,9
S07,10
S08,11
S09,12
S10,13
```
